Trace every image

Rights should never be invisible.

Cellwear uses real scientific imagery only when its source and reuse status can be documented. The archive combines public-domain work with Creative Commons images, preserving the credit and license attached to every field.

IMAGE 001 / PUBLIC DOMAIN

Breast cancer cell

A breast cancer cell photographed with a scanning electron microscope. The image shows the cell’s surface at high magnification; it should not be used by itself to identify or diagnose cancer.

Creator
Unknown photographer
Source
National Cancer Institute, 1980
Method
Scanning electron microscopy
Rights
Public domain; U.S. National Institutes of Health work

How the files were prepared

Optimized for the web. Not altered for meaning.

Cellwear converted source files to WebP, stripped metadata, and resized them for faster page loading. No labels, structures, or scientific interpretation were added. Creative Commons adaptations retain their original license, including ShareAlike where required. Product mockups are separate concept assets identified as microscopy-inspired art rather than medical imagery.
